label: neiso109 gas repair
definition: NEISO keeper. The 2026-09-09-neiso-108-fuelvintage recipe replayed across ALL SIX registry years 2020-2025 in ONE invocation and ONE bundle, with the REPAIRED data/raw/gas-prices/algonquin_citygate_daily.csv as the ONLY difference -- ZERO ScenarioConfig choices move, the DOF ledger is carried byte-identical, and the neiso-106 authorized_price_tuning scalar 0.95470 is carried forward unchanged. THE REPAIR: the committed AGT file held 82 rows of OTHER TRADING HUBS' prices (Henry Hub, Chicago Citygate, Transco Z6 NY, SoCal, PG&E, Waha, Sumas, FGT and more), 69 of them through an extremum pattern with no Algonquin anchor at all; plus 4 rows dated a week late by stale EIA republishes and 47 prints never scraped. Promoted on the owner's ruling of 2026-09-16 on rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] grounds, NOT on the residual. REPORTED AT FULL MAGNITUDE: oil moves AWAY from measured actual in four of six years (2023 -98.9%, 2024 -80.6%, 2025 +47.2%) while the gas family and the combined gas+oil pair both IMPROVE -- the repair changes the allocation, not the quantity. That is an OPEN ROOT-CAUSE ISSUE, not a caveat: ISO-NE's winter oil burn was being generated by contaminated gas prices crossing oil parity, and the successor is docs/CHARTER-neiso110-winter-oil-driver-2026-09-16.md. Two pre-registered gates fired and both trace to gates written wrong (G-1(iii) storage cyclic-SOC coupling; G-4 a 2021 dump identical in the control). G-DRIFT settled empirically at ZERO: the paired control leg reproduces the superseded keeper's committed 2025 bit-identically, 0 of 43,800 zone-hours.
market_story: CC_REGULAR carries New England's mid-merit block all year and sets price in most hours; its delivered gas is now the measured Algonquin citygate spot rather than, in 82 rows, another region's hub. OIL is the class this keeper changes and the class it does not yet explain: ISO-NE's dual-fuel steam and CT fleet burns distillate in winter because fuel-security obligations and pipeline nomination limits put it there -- the Winter Reliability / Inventoried Energy programs pay for stored energy and interruptible transport fails at any price -- and this model still reaches oil only through an hourly gas/oil parity test. With the contaminated New York and Waha prints removed, 2023 has no hour above parity at all, so modelled oil collapses while the measured 0.390 TWh stays where it was; and the model remains short 1.7 TWh of 2022 Elliott oil both before and after the repair. That gap is a missing MECHANISM, not a residual to buy back. NUCLEAR, HYDRO, WIND and SOLAR are unchanged to 0.0 ppm -- the repair touches only the gas-priced fleet.
